subject: Short courses introducing MSstats - Computation & statistics for targeted proteomics at NEU in May

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Short courses introducing MSstats - Computation & statistics for targeted proteomics at NEU in May
parts:
Dear MSstats users,

The registration for Computation & statistics for targeted proteomics short course at Northeastern University in May is open. (http://olga-vitek-lab.org/neu-short-course/) Brendan Maclean at University of Washington, Principal developer of Skyline, and Dr. Olga Vitek at Northeastern University are organizers. MSstats developers will join. We offer a lot of statistics and R including MSstats. Also there will be extra chance to talk about other specific topics which you are interested.

Please keep checking the MSstats webpage (http://msstats.org/news/, 'Short courses introducing MSstats') for other opportunities.

Looking forward to meeting you at these events.

- Meena
